fact: Car 20 left the track whilst Car 22 was attempting to overtake in Turn 11 on Lap 1.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. Car 22 was attempting to overtake Car 20 and was, according to the Driving Standard Guidelines, in a position to do so, however after the apex the driver of Car 22 did not allow Car 20 "a fair and acceptable width..from the apex to the exit of the corner" as specified in those Guidelines. This resulted in Car 20 being forced to leave the track to avoid a collision. In doing so, Car 20 retained its position.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 20 Alleged Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
to: The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
